# Artemis Atelier Ltd

> Lagos, Nigeria design and construction firm (CAC RC 1484495), in practice since 2010. Designs, builds and renovates homes, estates, churches and commercial buildings in Lagos and Ogun State, for clients in Nigeria and the diaspora (UK, US, Canada and beyond).

- Website: https://artemisatelierltd.com
- Address: 70B Olorunlogbon Street, Anthony Village, Lagos, Nigeria
- Phone/WhatsApp: +234 803 350 2393
- Email: info@artemisatelierltd.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 09:00-17:00 West Africa Time (UTC+1)
- Services: design and build, renovation and interior finishing, facility management and commercial construction, project management for clients building from abroad
- Advisory services (fixed fee, price on request): feasibility and cost reports, land title verification, design-only packages (plans and approval drawings), independent construction monitoring of builds by other contractors
- How we protect clients: stage payments released only after each stage is checked before payment by the client's choice of our named inspection team (chief inspector Engr. J.O. Owolabi; adjunct inspector Arch. E.A. Nwabueze; inspector Engr. Bello Hasani), an independent COREN-registered firm from our inspector panel, or the client's own inspector, open-book bills of quantities, live site cameras and weekly reports, contractor's all-risk insurance with a NAICOM-licensed insurer chosen by the client, policy in the client's name (subject to policy terms), 6-12 month defects liability period, full handover pack, private client portal
- Team: Chief Chinedu Edward Makama, MBA (Managing Director); Engr. Utibe Collins Nneke, MNSE, COREN R.74112 (Consultant Civil Engineer); Tobi Awojobi, BSc, MSc Quantity Surveying (Executive Director); Olasunkanmi Oladiran, Esq. (Head of Legal). Full team: https://artemisatelierltd.com/people
- Building cost in Lagos (2026, excluding land): about NGN 150,000-450,000 per square metre depending on finish
